OmaTasks can now show a tab for just some of your Todoist folders, so a work laptop can list only work projects. The bar count follows the folder filter you set on Today.

<img width="860" alt="The display menu before and after: a new Folder row under Filter opens a checklist of projects, with Pro partly checked" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b524ef6b-6f3b-4a69-ade4-0f679e2cc9d7" />
<img width="860" alt="The same display menu and Folder checklist in the dark theme" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/908e1f7d-7af6-4ab8-a87e-20997e510290" />

## New

- **Filter a tab by project folder.** The display menu has a new **Folder** row under Filter, a checklist of your projects indented by level. Checking a folder checks its subfolders, any of which you can uncheck, and several siblings can be checked at once. A parent shows a dash when only part of it is checked, and the closed row names the selection, such as `Pro (3/4)`. Subprojects created later join a checked folder automatically. Each tab keeps its own selection on this machine, and with nothing checked, nothing changes. By @joemugen (Joe FRANCOIS) in [#22](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/22).
- **The bar count follows Today's folder filter.** The number in the bar counts only the folders checked on Today. The other panel filters still do not affect it. By @joemugen in [#22](https://github.com/crmne/omatasks/pull/22).

## Known limitations

- The filter narrows what a tab already lists. Today and Upcoming only contain dated tasks, so a folder without any looks empty there.

## Validation

136 JavaScript tests, 24 composer UI checks, 18 list interaction checks, 6 folder filter checks, and 5 bar checks passed. QML parsing, shell syntax checks, and Omarchy plugin validation also passed. `tests/check-folder` clicks the real folder rows offscreen and checks the saved selection.

## Install

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omatasks.git --enable
```

Requires Omarchy Quattro and a Todoist account. Existing users can update the plugin through Omarchy.
